command:
set -eu
server_ip=10.100.62.10
command -v nc
ping_reply=$(printf 'PING\n' | nc -w 3 "$server_ip" 9097)
bad_reply=$(printf 'HELLO\n' | nc -w 3 "$server_ip" 9097)
printf 'sequential PING=%s OTHER=%s\n' "$ping_reply" "$bad_reply"
[ "$ping_reply" = PONG ]
[ "$bad_reply" = ERROR ]
client_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/legacy-clients.XXXXXX)
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 20 ]; do
  if [ $((i % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then request=PING; expected=PONG; else request=OTHER; expected=ERROR; fi
  (reply=$(printf '%s\n' "$request" | nc -w 5 "$server_ip" 9097); printf '%s\n' "$reply" > "$client_dir/$i.out"; [ "$reply" = "$expected" ]) &
  i=$((i + 1))
done
wait
pong_count=$(grep -l '^PONG$' "$client_dir"/*.out | wc -l)
error_count=$(grep -l '^ERROR$' "$client_dir"/*.out | wc -l)
file_count=$(find "$client_dir" -type f | wc -l)
printf 'concurrent completed=%s PONG=%s ERROR=%s\n' "$file_count" "$pong_count" "$error_count"
[ "$file_count" -eq 20 ]
[ "$pong_count" -eq 10 ]
[ "$error_count" -eq 10 ]
rm -r "$client_dir"
